units.source_text: 古歌：“遍地女郎花，伴花宿亦佳。

en.t: An old poem says, “Maidenflowers spread across the fields; it is pleasant to spend the night among the blossoms too.

units.source_text: 时人讥好色，漫把恶名加。”

en.t: People of the time mocked him as lustful, carelessly laying a bad name upon him.”

units.source_text: 此诗根据此歌，以女郎花比众侍女。

en.t: This poem is based on that old song, comparing the maidenflowers to the many waiting women.
